messages:
marc: Customer X asked for a full request/response bundle for a security audit; includes attachments. Is there an approved export flow?

kelly: We have redacted exports today, but not a controlled unmask process. We should add a two-stage export: (1) PREPARE - redacted sample + cost estimate; (2) REQUEST_UNMASK - kicks legal + ops approval for temporary unredacted access.

tanvi: Agree. Important: attachments (pdfs/images) and embeddings need nonreversible fingerprints. Proposal: compute per-tenant HMAC of attachment binary and store only hmac, mime, size, and OCRed redacted text. For embeddings, compute signed locality-sensitive hash (LSH) or bloom signature for match queries.

marc: Also need per-export budget cap and estimated token burn. Console should display projected token and storage cost and require approver.

kelly: API sketch:
```
POST /internal/exports
{
  "tenant_id": "t-42",
  "start_ts": 6209000000,
  "end_ts": 6212000000,
  "redaction_profile": "standard",
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "attachment_mode": "hmac_ocr",
  "max_token_budget": 2000000
}
```
Response returns export_id and sample_preview_url.

tanvi: Backend rules: default redacted export stores only hashes/fingerprints + redacted text and confidence. Unmask path requires legal ticket id, owner approver, and 2FA. Unmasked artifacts encrypted with per-tenant KMS key and TTL=30d by default. Every access generates an immutable audit event.

jena-legal: Legal: any unredacted export must include justification, approver identity, and retention <= 30 days unless court order. Keep immutable audit log and key escrow for emergencies.

ops-bot: FYI: export worker can affect read QPS. Default concurrency limit = 3 per tenant. Canary planned Sat 02:00 UTC at 2% traffic.

marc: Thumbs-up. I'll write RFC covering: console 2-step UX, API, fingerprints, bloom-signature for embeddings, KMS patterns, retention, approval flow, quotas. Tag security & legal.

kelly: Please include key-rotation and HMAC salt rotation plan so fingerprints remain meaningful for window.

tanvi: Also add a search-probe API so customers can submit a file to check presence via HMAC without revealing content.

marc: Thanks all — RFC incoming.
